chunks: Then, as the harbinger of happy news arrived and put the garment over his face his eyesight was restored. He said: "Did I not tell you? I know from God what you do not know."
ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Joseph regain his sight according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In this verse, the 'bashir' (bearer of good news) is identified by Shia exegetes as Jacob's youngest son, Benjamin, whose arrival triggered the restoration of Jacob's sight through the garment of Joseph. This event serves as a pivotal confirmation of Jacob's prophetic intuition and divine favor, illustrating how patience in adversity leads to the unveiling of hidden truths. The verse underscores the Shia emphasis on the continuity of divine knowledge passed from prophets to their successors, validating Jacob's earlier claim of knowing what his brothers did not.
